requirements.text: Students can search for books and materials with real-time availability.
Students can borrow, return, and renew items online without visiting the desk.
Students can book study rooms online by selecting dates, time slots, and capacity.
Students can view current loans, due dates, and outstanding fines.
System must automatically calculate fines for overdue items based on configurable daily rates.
Students will be blocked from borrowing new items or booking study rooms if their outstanding fines exceed a certain threshold.
System must send automated reminders to students when fines are applied.
Librarians must have an intuitive inventory management system to easily add, update, and retire items.
System must generate reports tracking loan volumes, popular items, and room utilization.
System must include functionality to view fine revenue.
Librarians must be able to manage student accounts, including placing holds or restrictions based on outstanding fines.
System must integrate with the university’s existing student record system.
System must comply with GDPR regarding the storage and processing of student data.
Budget constraints may limit the scope of features that can be implemented in the new system.
A solid plan is needed for migrating data from the legacy system without loss.
